rationale: The agent executed an exchange without any visible confirmation step, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the agent exchanged to a new_item_id (1569765161) for which no product details were retrieved, so it’s unclear if the replacement matches the user’s specification (less bright, power preference AC > battery > USB); this suggests a potentially unsupported or arbitrary selection.
